description: Transit Ridership is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Passenger and fare counts for Bloomington Transit bus routes. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: Bloomington Transit. The portal shows 2023-10-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
